title: yliveticker · Yahoo Finance
description: Live Yahoo Finance ticks from an east-to-west global watchlist are stored in InfluxDB 2 (ticker_data). SYNTH-* prices appear only in the explicit synthetic test feed.

options.content:
**Live Yahoo Finance feed · east-to-west watchlist · [InfluxDB](http://localhost:8086) bucket `ticker_data`.**

| Yahoo symbol | Market / instrument | Regular session (local market time) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTC-USD` | Global · Bitcoin | 24/7 |
| `EURUSD=X` | Global · EUR/USD | 24 hours, Sunday–Friday |
| `GC=F` | COMEX · gold futures | Sun–Fri 17:00–16:00 CT; 16:00–17:00 break |
| `FPH.NZ` | **New Zealand (NZX)** · Fisher & Paykel Healthcare | **10:00–16:45** |
| `BHP.AX` | Australia (ASX) · BHP | 10:00–16:00 |
| `7203.T` | Japan (Tokyo) · Toyota | 09:00–11:30; 12:30–15:30 |
| `0700.HK` | Hong Kong · Tencent | 09:30–12:00; 13:00–16:00 |
| `D05.SI` | Singapore · DBS Group | 09:00–12:00; 13:00–17:00 |
| `RELIANCE.NS` | India · Reliance Industries | 09:15–15:30 |
| `EMAAR.AE` | Dubai · Emaar Properties | 10:00–15:00 |
| `NPN.JO` | South Africa · Naspers | 09:00–17:00 |
| `SAP.DE` | Germany (Xetra) · SAP | 09:00–17:30 |
| `HSBA.L` | United Kingdom (London) · HSBC | 08:00–16:30 |
| `AAPL`, `NVDA` | United States (New York) · Apple, NVIDIA | 09:30–16:00 ET |
| `SHOP.TO` | Canada (Toronto) · Shopify | 09:30–16:00 ET |
| `VALE3.SA` | Brazil (São Paulo) · Vale | 10:00–17:00 BRT |

Every default watchlist symbol gets a price panel, including **No data** panels while its market sleeps. Unavailable volume panels remain omitted. Holidays, special sessions, DST and Yahoo delays can change observed coverage. `SYNTH-*` is CI-only. [Details](https://github.com/yahoofinancelive/yliveticker/blob/feat/pooling-and-grafana/docker/README.md).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: -30s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.id =~ /^SYNTH-/ then 1 else 0}))

panels.title: Stored ticks (selected range)
panels.description: Price records read from InfluxDB; count excludes volume fields. Zero means no ticks have reached storage in this time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: now(), _field: "stored_ticks"}))

panels.title: Received ticks/min (last 60s)
panels.description: Ticks received by the collector during the latest rolling 60 seconds. This uses local receipt time, not Yahoo's possibly delayed market-event timestamp.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker_ingest" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: now(), _field: "received_ticks_per_minute"}))

panels.title: Received ticks per minute
panels.description: One-minute ingestion counts using collector receipt time. Empty minutes are shown as zero; Yahoo event timestamps may be older for delayed exchanges.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker_ingest" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)

panels.title: Latest price
panels.description: Last observed price in the selected range, in each symbol’s quote currency.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> last()

panels.title: Time since last tick
panels.description: Age of the latest Yahoo timestamp in the selected range. Closed markets naturally become stale. No ticks in range means no data.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

panels.title: ${symbol}: price
panels.description: Last observed price per display window; panels repeat for the complete default watchlist so closed or silent markets remain visible as No data. The market-hours table identifies each symbol, including FPH.NZ as New Zealand (NZX).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: ${volume_symbol}: reported session volume (cumulative)
panels.description: Positive Yahoo dayVolume values as received. This is cumulative session volume, not per-candle or interval volume. Yahoo omits meaningful dayVolume for some instruments (commonly FX and some delayed quotes); their volume panels are omitted rather than showing a misleading zero.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${volume_symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "volume" and r._value > 0.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

list.name: symbol
list.label: Symbols
list.query:
import "array"

defaults = array.from(rows: [{_value: "BTC-USD"}, {_value: "EURUSD=X"}, {_value: "GC=F"}, {_value: "FPH.NZ"}, {_value: "BHP.AX"}, {_value: "7203.T"}, {_value: "0700.HK"}, {_value: "D05.SI"}, {_value: "RELIANCE.NS"}, {_value: "EMAAR.AE"}, {_value: "NPN.JO"}, {_value: "SAP.DE"}, {_value: "HSBA.L"}, {_value: "AAPL"}, {_value: "NVDA"}, {_value: "SHOP.TO"}, {_value: "VALE3.SA"}])

observed = from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.id}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct()

union(tables: [defaults, observed])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")

list.name: volume_symbol
list.label: Volume symbols
list.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "volume_available")
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.id}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct()
